riasec_teaser.title: What is your orientation profile?
riasec_teaser.desc: Click on the activity that appeals to you most to discover an overview of your professional temperament.

R.activity: Do DIY, build, farm or repair physical objects.
R.desc: You like concrete action, outdoor or manual work. Careers in engineering, agriculture, logistics or technical fields will suit you perfectly!

I.activity: Solve puzzles, do research or analyze theories.
I.desc: You are curious, analytical and you like to understand how things work. Careers in science, medicine, research or software development await you!

A.activity: Create, draw, imagine concepts, play music.
A.desc: You have a strong imagination, you like originality and you need to express yourself freely. Explore careers in design, communication, fashion or journalism!

S.desc: You are people-oriented, you like to listen, help and transmit. The fields of teaching, social work, health or human resources are made for you!

E.activity: Manage projects, convince, sell or negotiate.
E.desc: You are dynamic, persuasive and you enjoy leadership and challenges. Look towards management, business, communication or business creation!

C.activity: Organize data, manage numbers or plan tasks.
C.desc: You appreciate order, precision and methodology. Jobs in finance, administrative management, accounting or database management will please you!

hero.text1: Making a decision about your future is a big deal. At Avenir Assuré, we help you see things clearly, with no pressure and no judgment. Our goal: that every decision — academic, professional, or personal — is made with confidence.
hero.text2: You don't have to choose alone. We build your future together with you.

mission.title: A commitment, not just a slogan
mission.text1: The name Avenir Assuré isn't just a slogan. It's a commitment. Whether you're a student, an employee, a job seeker, or a future entrepreneur, you deserve to leave with clear ideas and a real action plan.
mission.text2: Guidance doesn't stop at an exam or a diploma. It follows you throughout your life, through every change, every doubt, every new beginning. Avenir Assuré is here to support you, today and tomorrow.

scolaire.desc: We help students get to know themselves better so they can choose a track that truly suits them.

post_bac.desc: Parcoursup, schools, universities: we help you choose the training that's right for you, based on your profile and your goals.

professionnelle.desc: Unsure about your career? We take stock together and identify the jobs that are made for you.

demandeurs_emploi.desc: We help you regain a clear direction and build a concrete plan to land a job.

entrepreneuriale.desc: We help you structure your project and launch it with confidence, without going off in every direction.

transition.desc: Changing careers or professional life takes preparation. We support you every step of the way.

ecoute.desc: Before advising you, we take the time to understand who you are and what you want.

methodes.desc: Tests, assessments, interviews: our tools are proven and tailored to your situation.

accompagnement.desc: No one-size-fits-all answers. Every journey deserves real, personalized follow-up.

cotes.desc: One appointment is never enough. We stay with you for as long as you need.

cta_final.title: Ready to move forward?
cta_final.desc: A doubt, a question, a desire to change direction? Contact us for a first conversation, no strings attached.

services_page.title: Support at every step
services_page.subtitle: Whatever your age or situation, there's support suited to your needs.

scolaire.intro: In middle school and high school, guidance decisions come up fast — sometimes too fast. We help students and their parents take the time to think it through, so they can choose a path that truly makes sense.
propose: Guidance assessments suited to the student's age
Interviews with the student, and parents if needed
Discovering general, technological, and vocational tracks
scolaire.pourQui: Middle and high school students and their families.

post_bac.intro: Parcoursup, top schools, universities, apprenticeships... there are so many options it's easy to get lost. We help you choose based on what you really want, not just rankings.
propose: Analysis of your skills and interests
Help writing your dissertation and preparing your presentation
post_bac.pourQui: High school seniors, students considering a change of direction.

professionnelle.intro: Going in circles in your career? No longer sure of your path? We take stock with you to identify your real strengths and the jobs that suit you.
professionnelle.pourQui: Employees in doubt, managers, professionals looking for meaning.

demandeurs_emploi.intro: Job hunting can wear you down. We help you regain direction, showcase your strengths, and structure your search so you can move forward with peace of mind.
propose: Help with your CV and cover letter
demandeurs_emploi.pourQui: Job seekers, people actively looking for work.

entrepreneuriale.intro: Starting a business is exciting but risky without preparation. We help you validate your idea and build solid foundations before you launch.
propose: Guidance toward the right funding options

transition.intro: Changing careers or industries doesn't happen by chance. We help you turn this change into a well-managed step, not one you're forced into.

about_page.text1: We believe no guidance decision should be made in doubt. That's why Avenir Assuré exists: to support you at every key stage, from middle school to career change.
about_page.text2: Our team brings together guidance counselors, work psychologists, and employment integration experts. Their goal: turning your questions into a plan, and your plan into success.
